sequence_semantics: All 36 blocks form one ordered sequence from cold state. Carry the independently calculated next state into the next block.
prediction_rule: Inputs contain no expected output or next state. Never use the result artifact to seed state, flags, filtered samples, tiers or positions.
input_word_format: Each input_f32_u32 is an authoritative little-endian IEEE-754 binary32 word array of length 256.
